svg.text: Scope (R-4151): ONLY the garment boxes. The figure under them is the existing block figure, drawn for context and unchanged. Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
Afghan man — perahan tunban, waistcoat, pakol
a pale blue-grey knee-length tunic, open sides, over BAGGY
trousers (+50 % wide) gathered in a narrow cuff at the ankle;
the long shirt to the knee (side slits left open) over very
baggy trousers gathered at the ankle
a dark vest over the tunic: two front panels with the shirt
showing between, a back panel, two straps
the flat round wool cap with a thick rolled rim and a flat top,
a little wider than the head
a large wrapped turban, wider and taller than the head, layer
on layer, a loose tail hanging down the back
a wool shawl over the shoulders, down the back and over one
shoulder to the front, a dark hem
the women's full-body pleated cover from crown to ankle in the
iconic light blue, a dark mesh grille over the eyes, the face
perahan tunban, a large lungee with its tail, a patu round the
shoulders (and a long beard, by the face shader)
Afghan fighter — turban, chest rig, patu
an olive tunic and baggy trousers, a BLACK lungee turban, an
ammunition chest rig, a patu over the shoulders (turbans:
Afghan boy — small perahan tunban, pakol
the same dress at a boy's size (the figure's height scales it)
Afghan girl — bright dress, trousers, scarf
a bright dress over loose trousers and a coloured headscarf
